resources.string: Camera preferences stay on this device. Purchases and restoration use Google Play.

Buy a single camera or the All Cameras Lifetime pack, which includes future cameras. Restore in Google Play with the Google Play account used to buy it. Purchases from another store do not transfer automatically.
Restore camera purchases for your current Google Play account in Google Play.
Purchase cancelled. Your existing camera unlocks are unchanged.
A purchase is no longer active. Other valid camera purchases remain available.
Payment is pending. Your selected purchase will unlock after Google Play confirms payment.
Couldn’t load the selected purchase from Google Play. Try another option or check your connection and retry.
